# IGTrack

> Evidence-first Instagram observation engine. Self-hosted, JSON-first CLI plus a
> stdio MCP server with 38 tools. Every stored value carries its source, time,
> confidence and SHA-256 hash; anything the platform does not expose is reported
> UNAVAILABLE with a reason instead of zero.

IGTrack is for operators who are authorized to observe an account and need to
prove what changed. It runs entirely on your infrastructure, stores observations
in PostgreSQL, and answers only from rows it actually recorded. Partial reads are
labelled and never diffed, so a truncated scan cannot become a false claim.

- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later
- Runtime: Node.js >= 22, PostgreSQL 16
- Install: `git clone https://github.com/AswinJava/igtrack && pnpm install && pnpm igtrack setup`
- Default demo path is synthetic fixture data, labelled `_meta.synthetic: true`.

## Surfaces

- CLI: `igtrack <command>` — JSON by default, human rendering on request
- MCP: `igtrack mcp` exposes the same operations over stdio
- Workers: `pnpm worker` runs the job queue

## Core invariants

1. Never zero-fill a value that was not observed.
2. Refusals are typed and carry a reason; "could not look" is not "absent".
3. Evidence classes are never merged.
4. A partial read is never diffed.
5. Facts are never dropped, replayed or downgraded.
6. The capability registry decides what is possible, not ad-hoc code.
7. No fabricated absence, no secrets in output, no unmetered synthetic paths.
